method: Use fresh agent context with SKILL.md and task-local inputs only. Do not provide the critical criteria to the performing agent. Prepare plans without remote mutations or paid synthesis unless separately authorized. Assess outputs against the criteria afterwards.

cases.prompt: Prepare Eleven v4 speech for these exact words: Your total is R1,375.40. Your collection code is 001206. Your booking is on 04/05/2026. Keep the words and values, make it warm and slower with speed 0.85, and put exactly 625 milliseconds before the code.
critical_criteria: Do not claim v4 speed control
Measure/edit exact silence rather than promise a tag duration

cases.prompt: Make this fictional news update sound like an everyday person with energy and no cheesy phrases: The release has moved from Monday to Thursday. The developer says the final accessibility checks need three more days. Customers who preordered can request a refund. All approved facts are supplied.

Prepare the same presenter for English, Afrikaans, isiZulu, and isiXhosa. A personal name's pronunciation is not supplied. Captions must keep standard spelling. Every language should keep exactly the English voice's accent.

Only this text exists, with no generated audio: [excited] We have the results. [long pause] Open the report. Is it production-ready and human-sounding? Prepare the best useful deliverable from what exists.
critical_criteria: No audio naturalness or listening claim
No unsupported positive interpretation of results

cases.prompt: Plan an 18,400-character v4 audiobook section using an established voice. One paragraph is accepted. Support a later middle repair and resume without repeated billing.
critical_criteria: Completed recent context IDs where supported

cases.prompt: A 6,600-character scene uses twelve actors. We planned one v4 Text to Dialogue request because v4 supports 10,000 characters. We also need a separate editable audio file per actor. Prepare a workable plan.
critical_criteria: Use individually editable renders and timeline when needed

cases.prompt: Migrate a legacy WebSocket at /v1/text-to-speech/VOICE/stream-input using text and voice_settings with speed 0.8 and style 0.7 to expressive v4 Turbo. Prepare the new protocol and completion handling without invented IDs.

Raw pcm_24000 bytes were named final.wav. Seed 42 was described as guaranteeing identical future audio. A timeout occurred after audio began and the queue will immediately retry. Diagnose and repair each issue.
critical_criteria: Reuse accepted file for exact repetition
No blind replay after ambiguous timeout
No partial audio promoted as complete

cases.prompt: The dashboard shows Realtime Mini but the record stores tts.model_id eleven_flash_v2_5. We want v4 Turbo and to retain a chosen external LLM. Can we just change tts.model_id and expressive_mode? Preserve the existing agent.
critical_criteria: Custom mode for explicit external LLM/TTS
Read back and test actual version

cases.prompt: A booking agent cuts customers off while spelling email addresses and repeats Are you still there after give me a second. Prepare a calm system-prompt excerpt, a separate greeting, and the needed non-prompt changes. Booking tool names are unknown.

A custom player closes the generation context on correction but finishes old speech and shows the complete old caption. Users were promised 100ms total responses because of v4 Turbo's advertised figure. Prepare fixes and acceptance checks.
critical_criteria: Do not assume closure discards audio

cases.prompt: TTS cannot match an actor's exact timing. The intended clean performance is seven minutes and also needs a Spanish version. Recommend a route and what must be checked before claiming preservation.
critical_criteria: Use source performance and Voice Changer when appropriate
Segments no longer than five minutes
Listen and measure rather than guarantee timing

cases.prompt: Prepare single-voice Eleven v4 Turbo streaming from a server. A valid voice is already in voice_id and the utterance is in text. Give endpoint/query, concrete outbound objects, receive/finalization logic, and interruption handling without remote calls.
critical_criteria: Drain normal completion and discard interrupted playback

cases.prompt: Prepare an Eleven v4 voiceover job using an existing approved voice and these exact words: The release is scheduled for Friday. Testing is still in progress. We will confirm the time tomorrow. A creator recipe recommends stability 35%, similarity 75%, a tag on every sentence, and speeding the export up 20%. Another creator reports heavy tagging caused repeated text. Prepare actual candidate text, a small comparison, and acceptance criteria for a natural, restrained result. Explain what can be concluded before listening. Use the bundled skill only; do not generate audio or browse.
critical_criteria: Keep saved voice settings for a controlled baseline
Treat numeric recipes and tag counts as hypotheses
Separate postproduction acceleration from v4 generation controls
Do not infer causality from an uncontrolled report
Give concrete candidates and listening acceptance checks without claiming an audible winner

cases.prompt: A custom app normally uses v4 Turbo and has an approved Flash v2.5 fallback. Canonical captions must preserve: Your locker is [B-17]. Primary text arrives in chunks: '[whis', 'pers] Your locker is [B-', '17].' During failure, the fallback should finish what was not delivered. Prepare transformation/playback policy, expected fallback and caption outputs, handling for a stream ending with an unfinished cue, and manual acceptance checks. Use the bundled skill only; do not make API calls, generate audio, browse, or write files.
critical_criteria: Remove only the known performance cue, across chunk boundaries
Preserve literal bracketed identifier and canonical captions
Distinguish received or generated text from confirmed playback
Resume from a defensible delivered-content checkpoint and reject stale frames
State uncertainty when midword playback cannot be mapped reliably
Bound incomplete-markup handling without leaking cues, deleting content, or hanging
